parsed.explanation: Thin dossier with no documented trans-specific criminal offence, police targeting, facility/custody rule, or violence, and a documented 2014 repeal of the sodomy offence with official equality signals. No documented social acceptance or working visitor remedies either; entry, facilities, custody and care are open questions. Per rubric, missing resident LGR/anti-discrimination machinery is not itself visitor exposure, so unknowns hold this a step below documented acceptance-with-protections, but above 0.55 cases with recurring documented harms.

federal_state_facilities.interaction: No subnational variation documented; repeal applied nationwide.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No trans-specific penalty or enforcement measure documented; no GI protective provision documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: 2014 Penal Code repealed sodomy offence; state joined 2011 joint statement against SOGI violations and in 2019 head of state endorsed full equality.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official reform signals suggest non-hostile state framing, but absence of GI protection is largely resident-facing per rubric, not a documented visitor exposure.

minors_guardians.interaction: No age-specific rule documented for travelling minors or guardians.

street_violence_police_response.interaction: No incident records, killing figures, or background rate documented; absence is not evidence of safety.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No anti-discrimination statute covering SO/GI documented; no visitor remedy documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Resident anti-discrimination/LGR absence is a climate signal only and should not be counted as visitor exposure without documented border/document practice.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in having no trans criminalisation and uncertainty on custody, but 0.65-C has documented third-gender acceptance and a court compensation award. This dossier lacks those positives, so it sits below 0.65.

0.55-A has documented recurring hotel/cafe refusals, threat-framing by some residents, and only partial corrections. This dossier documents no such recurring visitor harms, so it sits above 0.55 despite unknowns.

0.75-C documents accepted foreign documents, identity-based facilities/wards, and enforced compensation. None of those visitor-facing protections are documented here, so it sits materially below 0.75.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime is nationally uniform with no subnational layer. The operative documented facts are decriminalisation and reformist official signals versus complete silence on borders, facilities, custody, care, policing and violence. Extrapolating from repeal and state equality statements points away from organised targeting, but without documented acceptance or working remedies the unknowns cannot be treated as safety. That uncertainty, not resident LGR/marriage gaps, anchors the rating between elevated-risk documented-harm cases and reduced-risk protected cases.
